claim: Iter 38 Iso-Yield cross-library elevation: on tinker_gsm8k Qwen3-8B, per-prompt anti-herding delta_div = +0.122 (SEM 0.013, n=600 prompts). Using this measured bonus as the library-level correction (Tinker rollout workers, reward parser, KL shared across all 9 variance-mitigation libraries), the iso-yield curve at Y_target=0.80 saves one rollout per prompt on every library: 25.0% cost savings on the 5 in-vanilla libraries (grpo, aero, cppo, ngrpo, scafgrpo) and 20.0% on the 4 sub-vanilla libraries (mcgrpo, gift, areal, es). The 14-row LOO 3-NN failure-mode classifier over (mean_zvf, mean_last10, mean_peak) attains 11/14 = 78.6% accuracy, +14.3pp over the reward-only baseline (9/14 = 64.3%), confirming ZVF carries non-redundant failure-mode signal. The frontier synthesis's 'Contrastive Yield' framing is now operationalised as a per-library cross-experiment diagnostic.

Iter 38 deliverables: scripts/zvf_iter38_crosslibrary.py (260 lines, 4 functions: load_by_library, load_contrastive_yield, iso_yield_iid, iso_yield_empirical, failure_class + knn_predict, main with 3-section pipeline); scripts/zvf_iter38_fig.py (130 lines, 3-panel matplotlib: iso-yield curves for 5 representative libs, per-library cost-savings bar chart at y=0.80, failure-mode confusion heatmap); experiments/results/zvf_iter38_isoyield.tsv (27 rows = 9 libs x 3 y_targets); experiments/results/zvf_iter38_classifier.tsv (14 rows + 4x4 confusion matrix + overall accuracy); experiments/results/zvf_iter38_summary.tsv (10-row one-rollup with delta_div, iso-yield savings, classifier accuracy, per-class recovery); figures/zvf_iter38.{pdf,png} (3-panel); paper/sections/zvf_iter38.tex (172 lines, balanced 133/133 braces, 5/5 begin/end, 5 labels, 2 tables, 1 figure, 3 subsections: iso-yield / classifier / headline) wired into paper/main.tex and paper/main_anon.tex after zvf_iter34.
